projects.title: Fly, you fools!
projects.description: Conceptualized and realized, following different software development methodologies, an endless-runner style, Java-based multiplayer game for Android phones that utilizes depth-first search algorithms and various other methods to avoid concurrency issues.

projects.title: Smart Suitcase
projects.description: Wrote programs in Python that automate the process of installation of devices to eliminate human errors, reduce cost of hiring extra manpower and reduce time taken to less than 5% of the original duration. Developed a website using JavaScript (Angular JS and Node JS, with experience with sending and receiving JSON files using REST) for ease of installation of other devices, better security and improvement on user-friendliness of the process.
